summary: Safer multiline trackpad text selection and one-time autocorrection rejection, preserving the verified offline voice hotfix.

changes.title: Guarded vertical trackpad selection
changes.detail: While holding Space, a second finger can request up/down selection within ordinary multiline editors. The editor determines visual lines, and the keyboard waits for an observed anchor-preserving selection instead of guessing offsets or inserting text. Unsupported and limited fields retain their existing selection.

changes.title: Autocorrection rejection lasts one use
changes.detail: After Backspace safely restores an autocorrected original word, the same proposed correction is suppressed once if immediately encountered again in the same editor. The short-lived record is memory-only and cleared on field changes, privacy transitions, unrelated commits and cursor updates.

changes.title: Existing voice and private data preserved
changes.detail: The verified voice crash hotfix remains unchanged; paused native GTCRN stays paused. No new models, cloud recognition, network permissions, signing changes, clipboard history changes, or learned-data resets. Oppo validation is still required for host-specific vertical movement.
